rules.text: Activate ACE for SillyTavern character-card, lorebook, World Info, key, regex, token-budget, or ACE maintenance work, and not for unrelated writing or programming.
rules.trigger: Every incoming request
rules.action: Apply the frontmatter boundary and classify only in-scope work.
rules.success: Trigger expectations match the held-out dataset.
rules.failure: A positive case is missed or an unrelated near-miss triggers.
rules.conflictResolution: The explicit SillyTavern artifact target wins over incidental creative-writing terms.
rules.correctiveAction: Revise description using train cases and rerun held-out cases.

rules.text: Follow DISCOVER, CLASSIFY, LOAD, PLAN, EXECUTE, VALIDATE, optional REPAIR, VERIFY, REPORT in order.
rules.trigger: ACE is active
rules.action: Record each state transition in the task evidence ledger.
rules.success: The state sequence is valid and reaches REPORT only after VERIFY.
rules.failure: A required state is missing, reordered, or skipped.
rules.conflictResolution: No user request to hurry permits skipping a gate.
rules.correctiveAction: Return to the first missing state and continue from there.

rules.text: Load every required reference for the selected workflow and no forbidden domain reference.
rules.trigger: Workflow classification is complete
rules.action: Read and record the path and SHA-256 of each required reference.
rules.success: Required references are evidenced and forbidden references are absent.
rules.failure: Reference evidence is missing or domains are mixed.
rules.conflictResolution: Combined repair loads both domain references but keeps separate gates.
rules.correctiveAction: Return to LOAD and rebuild the applicable rule set.

rules.text: Do not report PASS without fresh command, artifact, and manual-gate evidence for every applicable MUST.
rules.trigger: Before VERIFY or REPORT
rules.action: Validate the evidence ledger fail-closed.
rules.success: Every PASS gate contains evidence and there are no FAIL or BLOCKED gates.
rules.failure: PASS is asserted from confidence, checklist, missing command output, or self-report alone.
rules.conflictResolution: Unknown and unavailable states are BLOCKED, never PASS.
rules.correctiveAction: Run the missing verification or report BLOCKED.

rules.text: Repair every remediable mandatory failure and rerun its gate, for at most five full repair cycles.
rules.trigger: Any mandatory gate returns FAIL
rules.action: Record cause, correction, and a fresh rerun.
rules.success: The gate passes after repair or the run becomes objectively BLOCKED.
rules.failure: A remediable FAIL remains at REPORT.
rules.conflictResolution: Five exhausted repair cycles produce BLOCKED.
rules.correctiveAction: Repair and rerun; never relabel FAIL as N/A.

rules.text: Character-card JSON must satisfy the applicable SillyTavern V1, V2, or V3 structural contract.
rules.trigger: A character-card JSON artifact is created or changed
rules.action: Run the character validator on the final artifact.
rules.success: Required fields and container types are valid for the detected version.
rules.failure: The version is unknown or required structure is absent.
rules.conflictResolution: Official current source overrides community templates.
rules.correctiveAction: Repair the structure without inventing unsupported V3 requirements.
rules.naWhen: The deliverable is prose guidance only and contains no card artifact.

rules.text: Motivation and personality must be demonstrated through behavior while preserving creative freedom.
rules.trigger: Character prose is created or materially changed
rules.action: Review characterization with evidence from concrete fields.
rules.success: Behavior supports motivation and internal/external presentation is distinguishable where relevant.
rules.failure: The card is only labels, contradictions, or unsupported traits.
rules.conflictResolution: User-specified style wins if the semantic criteria still hold.
rules.correctiveAction: Revise behavior or explain the intentional exception.
rules.naWhen: No character prose is being authored or judged.

rules.text: Greetings must provide a playable entry and must not decide the user's thoughts or choices.
rules.trigger: A first or alternate greeting is created or changed
rules.action: Review the final greeting, not a summary of it.
rules.success: The user has an actionable opening and retains agency.
rules.failure: The text controls the user's decisions, feelings, or completed response.
rules.conflictResolution: Observed environmental facts are allowed; unchosen user intent is not.
rules.correctiveAction: Rewrite the controlled action as an open stimulus or consequence.

rules.text: Dialogue examples must support the intended voice and cannot be reduced to an exact universal count.
rules.trigger: Dialogue examples are created or changed
rules.action: Review voice coverage and consistency.
rules.success: Examples demonstrate the requested voice or modes without contradicting the card.
rules.failure: Examples are generic, contradictory, or encode user control.
rules.conflictResolution: Quality and coverage take precedence over a fixed number of START blocks.
rules.correctiveAction: Revise or add only the examples needed for coverage.
rules.naWhen: Dialogue examples are not in scope.

rules.text: A complete character card should ideally total 700–1500 tokens; totals outside the inclusive range produce an evidence-backed warning, never a failure by themselves.
rules.trigger: A complete character-card artifact is created, repaired, or token-audited
rules.action: Run the token audit on the complete card and retain the actual total, inclusive limits, and exact/estimate method.
rules.success: The report records the total and method; 700–1500 is accepted silently and any lower or higher total emits CARD_TOTAL_TOKEN_ADVISORY as WARN.
rules.failure: The advisory is omitted, an estimate is called exact, or an out-of-range total is promoted to an automatic card failure.
rules.conflictResolution: This user-selected total-card advisory is separate from community permanent-token heuristics; neither value is a structural SillyTavern limit.
rules.correctiveAction: Warn with evidence and review repetition or missing behavioral detail; do not rewrite or fail the card solely to hit the range.
rules.naWhen: The audited artifact is not a character card or no complete card artifact is available.

rules.text: Lorebook JSON must contain an entries object/array whose entries have valid content and field types.
rules.trigger: Lorebook JSON is created, changed, or audited
rules.action: Run the lorebook validator.
rules.success: The artifact uses valid native World Info or embedded Character Book structure.
rules.failure: JSON, entries, content, or field types are invalid.
rules.conflictResolution: Official source fields override legacy ACE aliases.
rules.correctiveAction: Normalize to the detected official container format.
rules.naWhen: No lorebook artifact is supplied or produced.

rules.text: selectiveLogic must be 0 AND ANY, 1 NOT ALL, 2 NOT ANY, or 3 AND ALL.
rules.trigger: An entry uses secondary keys or declares selectiveLogic
rules.action: Validate the numeric value and truth table.
rules.success: The value is 0..3 and matches the official behavior.
rules.failure: Unknown logic or altered mapping is accepted.
rules.conflictResolution: Current source code is authoritative.
rules.correctiveAction: Replace the value and rerun positive and negative cases.

rules.text: Non-empty secondary keys require selective=true in ACE-authored output.
rules.trigger: keysecondary or secondary_keys is non-empty
rules.action: Set selective=true or remove stale secondary keys.
rules.success: Secondary filters are intentionally active or absent.
rules.failure: Secondary keys are silently ignored.
rules.conflictResolution: Audit treats stale ignored keys as a defect, not a warning.
rules.correctiveAction: Activate selective mode or delete the unused filters.

rules.text: Lorebook entries must be semantically scoped and standalone; token length is a contextual judgment, not a fixed limit.
rules.trigger: Entry content is created or changed
rules.action: Review final entry content and its purpose.
rules.success: Each entry is understandable when activated and avoids unrelated encyclopedic material.
rules.failure: Content is contextless, overloaded, or copied without task relevance.
rules.conflictResolution: User purpose and actual budget override the community 50–100 token heuristic.
rules.correctiveAction: Split, trim, or add the missing subject context.
rules.naWhen: No entry content is in scope.

rules.text: Activation regex keys must use JavaScript regex semantics and pass both positive and negative examples.
rules.trigger: A key begins with a JavaScript regex literal or regex behavior is requested
rules.action: Run the JavaScript key tester with should-match and should-not-match inputs.
rules.success: Every positive matches and every negative does not.
rules.failure: Syntax is invalid, a positive misses, or a negative matches.
rules.conflictResolution: Python regex results are non-authoritative.
rules.correctiveAction: Repair the JavaScript literal and rerun the complete case set.
rules.naWhen: No keys or regex are in scope.

rules.text: Key choice must be semantically connected to entry content and avoid obvious broad false activations.
rules.trigger: Activation keys are authored or audited
rules.action: Review the keys against content and expected chat language.
rules.success: Keys identify the entry subject and include necessary aliases without broad noise.
rules.failure: Keys are unrelated, dangerously generic, or omit obvious requested forms.
rules.conflictResolution: Observed user corpus beats generic key lists.
rules.correctiveAction: Narrow or expand aliases and add targeted examples.
rules.naWhen: No activation keys are in scope.

rules.text: Authored character and lorebook prose must not use replacement-by-negation rhetoric such as 'X is not A; X is B', 'not A but/rather B', or equivalent Russian constructions.
rules.trigger: Character-card or lorebook prose is created, rewritten, or audited
rules.action: State the intended fact directly and run the contrastive-negation style validator on the final prose artifact.
rules.success: No replacement-by-negation pattern is present in any authored prose field.
rules.failure: A sentence defines a subject by denying one label and replacing it with another through a mirrored or not/but construction.
rules.conflictResolution: This explicit owner constraint overrides community stylistic defaults; standalone factual negation without a replacement clause remains allowed.
rules.correctiveAction: Rewrite the passage as a direct positive description, then rerun VAL-STYLE.
rules.naWhen: No character or lorebook prose is created, changed, or audited.

rules.text: Authored character and lorebook prose must be semantically free of denial-then-replacement rhetoric even when wording, punctuation, language, or sentence boundaries evade automatic patterns.
rules.trigger: Character-card or lorebook prose is created, rewritten, or audited
rules.action: Review every in-scope prose field for semantic equivalents of replacement-by-negation and rewrite them as direct positive statements.
rules.success: An independent manual review finds no direct or disguised denial-then-replacement construction.
rules.failure: The construction remains through paraphrase, split sentences, metaphor, translation, or punctuation changes.
rules.conflictResolution: The explicit owner ban wins over rhetorical style preferences; ordinary standalone factual negation remains allowed.
rules.correctiveAction: State the intended positive fact directly and repeat the independent field review.
rules.naWhen: No character or lorebook prose is created, changed, or audited.

rules.text: Token reports must identify the tokenizer method and must not label an estimate as exact.
rules.trigger: A token budget or token count is reported
rules.action: Run the token checker with an explicit profile or estimate mode.
rules.success: The report includes method and exact/estimate status.
rules.failure: An unavailable exact tokenizer silently falls back while retaining an exact profile label.
rules.conflictResolution: Unavailability yields BLOCKED for exact requests and an explicit estimate otherwise.
rules.correctiveAction: Install the tokenizer or relabel and justify the estimate.

rules.text: Technical SillyTavern claims must cite current official source or documentation and resolve community conflicts explicitly.
rules.trigger: A technical behavior claim is introduced or maintained
rules.action: Link the claim to source metadata and a resolved conflict when needed.
rules.success: The source exists, is within review date, and conflicts are resolved.
rules.failure: A community statement overrides official behavior or the source is stale.
rules.conflictResolution: Source > official docs > observed behavior > bundled practical export > community > legacy ACE.
rules.correctiveAction: Refresh the official source and update affected rules/references/tests.
rules.naWhen: No technical claim is created or changed.

rules.text: The executable skill surface must contain no active legacy model-specific workflow and no working reference to the removed route; owner-reserved README files are reported as explicit exclusions.
rules.trigger: ACE repository validation
rules.action: Run stale-route and documentation checks.
rules.success: Historical names occur only in migration-notes.md or a declared owner-reserved README exclusion, and no removed directory exists.
rules.failure: A working file restores a model-specific route or deleted path.
rules.conflictResolution: Tokenizer package names are not workflows; routing files and instructions are forbidden.
rules.correctiveAction: Migrate useful model-neutral content and delete the route.

rules.text: Package scripts, executable instructions, references, validators, tests, schemas, and migration notes must agree with the real tree; owner-reserved README files are checked only after their exclusion is removed.
rules.trigger: ACE repository validation
rules.action: Check links, npm commands, declared validators, test IDs, and file existence.
rules.success: No non-excluded declared path, command, validator, or test is missing, and every exclusion is visible with a reason.
rules.failure: Documentation or registry describes nonexistent behavior.
rules.conflictResolution: Executable/package truth wins and docs must be corrected in the same change.
rules.correctiveAction: Repair the missing artifact or remove the false claim.

rules.text: Every automatable MUST must have an automatic validator and tests; every subjective mandatory criterion must have a manual gate.
rules.trigger: Rule registry validation
rules.action: Validate requirement traceability.
rules.success: No rule is orphaned and every cross-reference resolves.
rules.failure: A MUST lacks a gate/test or a manual gate lacks evidence criteria.
rules.conflictResolution: Unenforceable objective MUST is invalid until a gate exists.
rules.correctiveAction: Add the gate/test or correctly downgrade a non-objective preference.

rules.text: All active skill prose, instructions, headings, comments, examples, and exported rules must be English; Cyrillic is allowed only as an exact Russian regex, key, test-string, localized UI literal, or historical source path in the category-specific file allowlist.
rules.trigger: ACE files are created, translated, or changed
rules.action: Run the exact-hash language audit and RU-regex fidelity tests.
rules.success: Every Cyrillic line is an approved technical literal in a category-authorized file and every English explanation preserves the source rule.
rules.failure: Russian prose remains, an exception is stale, broad, or used in an unauthorized file, or a Russian regex literal changes semantics.
rules.conflictResolution: Regex and test literal fidelity has priority over stylistic smoothness; explanatory prose remains English.
rules.correctiveAction: Translate the prose or restore the exact technical literal, update the narrow exception hash, and rerun both gates.

rules.text: ACE must be self-contained: active execution may use only bundled repository rules and must not depend on an external local guide archive, extracted folder, absolute file path, or path that escapes the skill root.
rules.trigger: ACE sources, rule exports, references, fixtures, or maintenance instructions are changed
rules.action: Validate bundled source hashes, repository-relative locators, active source IDs, and the complete active surface for external dependency markers.
rules.success: Every runtime rule is present inside the repository, every bundled export is hash-bound and inside the skill root, and active source documents resolve only registered source IDs.
rules.failure: An active file requires a ZIP, extracted folder, file URL, absolute local path, escaping path, local-archive source, or unknown source ID.
rules.conflictResolution: Bundled, reviewed English rule exports are runtime authority; external source material is research input only and cannot be a runtime prerequisite.
rules.correctiveAction: Export the required rule into a bundled reference, remove the external locator, update its SHA-256 metadata, and rerun source validation.

rules.text: Combined repair must keep character and lorebook evidence, validators, and manual gates separate.
rules.trigger: A task modifies both character and lorebook artifacts
rules.action: Run both domain gate sets and record separate results.
rules.success: Neither domain borrows PASS evidence from the other.
rules.failure: One domain is skipped or its rules are applied to the other.
rules.conflictResolution: Shared token analysis may be reused, domain quality judgments may not.
rules.correctiveAction: Split the review and rerun both gate sets.
rules.naWhen: The selected workflow is not combined-repair.
